mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqSellerChoice2PopList*/ SELECT X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.DESCRIPTION || '/' || X.SPECIFICATION AS DESCR_SPEC, X.ITEM_QTY, X.MAKER_NAME, X.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, X.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.ORIGIN_NAME, X.BUYER, X.QUOTATION_NO, X.QUOTATION_SEQ, X.REVISION, X.END_TIME_FLAG, X.SEND_FLAG, X.CATLG_CODE, X.CMS_STD_FLAG, X.CMS_CATLG_ID, X.CMS_CATEG_ID, X.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG, X.AGENT_MIN_PRICE, NVL(X.RFQ_KEP_USER, (SELECT NVL(MAX(KEP_USER_ID),'') FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER=X.BUYER AND ITEM_GROUP=X.ITEM_GROUP AND STATUS='C' AND KEP_DEPT=(SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{USER_ID} AND STATUS ^='D') AND START_SCOPE<=AGENT_MIN_PRICE AND END_SCOPE>AGENT_MIN_PRICE AND KEP_USER_ID=#{USER_ID})) AS RFQ_KEP_USER, X.AGENT_MIN_PRICE, X.AGENT_REVISION FROM ( SELECT MAX(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M104' AND CODE=A.MAKER_CODE)) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE) AS BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, MAX(A.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE) AS ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(A.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE)) AS ORIGIN_NAME, A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, CASE WHEN MAX(B.ATOS_END_DATE)||MAX(B.ATOS_END_TIME) < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END_TIME_FLAG, MAX(DECODE(NVL( NVL((SELECT COUNT(QT1.AGENT) FROM KEPQTDT QT1 WHERE QT1.BUYER=B.BUYER AND QT1.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND QT1.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QT1.REVISION=B.REVISION AND QT1.STATUS IN ('C','R') GROUP BY QT1.BUYER, QT1.QUOTATION_NO, QT1.QUOTATION_SEQ, QT1.REVISION),0) - NVL((SELECT COUNT(QT2.AGENT) FROM KEPQTDT QT2 WHERE QT2.BUYER=B.BUYER AND QT2.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND QT2.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QT2.REVISION=B.REVISION AND QT2.SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND QT2.STATUS IN ('C','R') GROUP BY QT2.BUYER, QT2.QUOTATION_NO, QT2.QUOTATION_SEQ, QT2.REVISION),0),0), 0, 'Y','N')) AS SEND_FLAG, MAX((SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R'))) AS CATLG_CODE, MAX(NVL(CMS.STD_FLAG,'N'))CMS_STD_FLAG , MAX(DECODE(MK.VALUE1,0,DECODE(A.CMS_CATLG_ID,'TALK',A.CMS_CATLG_ID,'PASS',A.CMS_CATLG_ID,CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID),'NON'))CMS_CATLG_ID, MAX(NVL(CMS.CMS_CATEG_ID,NULL)) CMS_CATEG_ID, MAX(A.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG) REFER_MAPPING_FLAG, NVL((SELECT MIN(STOA_LIST_PRICE) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER=A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION=A.REVISION AND NVL(STOA_LIST_PRICE,0)>0 AND STATUS IN ('C','R')),0) AS AGENT_MIN_PRICE, MAX(A.RFQ_KEP_USER) AS RFQ_KEP_USER, MAX(A.ITEM_GROUP) AS ITEM_GROUP, MAX(B.AGENT_REVISION) AS AGENT_REVISION FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B , CMSCATLG CMS , ICOMCOD1 MK WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='N' AND B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'GA' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.CMS_CATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND CMS.STD_FLAG(+) = 'Y' AND A.MAKER_CODE = MK.CODE(+) AND MK.TYPE(+) = 'M104' AND MK.FLAG(+) = 'Y' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION ) X

A.QTDT_PROCESS_TYPE , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M034' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE = A.QTDT_PROCESS_TYPE) AS QTDT_PROCESS_NAME , A.WAREHOUSE_CODE , A.RFQ_IMG_TYPE , A.RFQ_IMG_FLAG , A.IMGFILE_DIR , A.IMGFILE_NAME , A.IMGFILE_NAME_IMG , A.QTDT_IMGFILE_DIR , A.QTDT_IMGFILE_NAME , A.QTDT_IMGFILE_NAME_IMG , A.TAX_TYPE , A.QTDT_TAX_TYPE_CODE , A.QTDT_TAX_TYPE , DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE QTDT.BUYER = A.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = A.REVISION AND , A.BELOW_COMORG_NAME , A.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE , A.AGENT_ITEM_MAKE_TYPE , A.RQDT_AGENT_NAME , A.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE) AS ASSIGN_AGENT_NAME , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(DEF.SLG_ID), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF DEF, BNTSLGIMP IMP WHERE DEF.SLG_ID = IMP.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DEF.OPEN_DATE AND DECODE(COUNT(DEF.SLG_ID), 0, 0, MAX(IMP.COL01_DATA)) FROM BNTSLGDEF DEF, BNTSLGIMP IMP WHERE DEF.SLG_ID = IMP.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DEF.OPEN_DATE AND DEF.CLOSE_DATE AND MAX(IMP.COL02_DATA)) FROM BNTSLGDEF DEF, BNTSLGIMP IMP WHERE DEF.SLG_ID = IMP.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DEF.OPEN_DATE AND DEF.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN IMP.OPEN_DATE AND IMP.CLOSE_DATE AND IMP.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND DEF.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-09') AS MAX_UNIT_PRICE FROM ( SELECT DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER=A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION=A.REVISION AND AGENT=B.AGENT AND STATUS <> 'D'), 1, '신규견적', '재견적요청') AS SOURCING_STATUS, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.AGENT AND STATUS <> 'D') AS AGENT_NAME, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND B.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN '***' ELSE TO_CHAR(NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0)) END AS STOA_LIST_PRICE, TRIM(B.STOA_REMARK) AS STOA_REMARK, DECODE(TRIM(B.STOA_REMARK),'','0','1') AS STOA_REMARK_IMG, B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.REVISION, B.AGENT, B.AGENT_REVISION, B.LEAD_TIME, TRIM(A.ATOS_REMARK) As ATOS_REMARK, NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, DECODE(A.BUYER, 'KRPOON0010', DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0,1,B.STOA_LIST_PRICE))*100,1)), 'KRDOOD0001', DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, '', ROUND(((B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0,1,B.STOA_LIST_PRICE))*100,1)), DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, '', ROUND(((B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0,1,B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE))*100,1)) ) AS RATE, B.MAKER_NAME, B.ORIGIN_NAME AS ORIGIN_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' and code=B.ORIGIN_NAME) CODE=A.MAKER_CODE) || '/' || (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS RQ_MAKER_ORIGIN_NAME , f_get_dss_chk(#{st_buyer_code},B.AGENT,0) AS DSS_YN , AND QT2.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND QT2.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QT2.REVISION=B.REVISION AND QT2.SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND QT2.STATUS IN ('C','R') GROUP BY QT2.BUYER, QT2.QUOTATION_NO, QT2.QUOTATION_SEQ, QT2.REVISION),0),0), 0, 'Y','N') AS SEND_FLAG , A.ITEM_GROUP , A.RFQ_KEP_USER , F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, A.CMS_CATEG_ID,#{USER_ID},1) AS SG_KEP_YN , F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, DECODE(A.SG_ID,'SG118','0','SG153','0','SG163','0',NVL(A.PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT CMPY.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = B.BUYER))) ELSE A.PROCESS_TYPE END AS PROCESS_TYPE , B.PROCESS_TYPE AS QTDT_PROCESS_TYPE , CASE WHEN #{st_sour_dept_yn} = 'Y' THEN DECODE(A.SG_ID,'SG118','','SG153','','SG163','',NVL(A.WAREHOUSE_CODE,(SELECT CMPY.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER))) ELSE A.WAREHOUSE_CODE END AS WAREHOUSE_CODE ,NVL(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE,DECODE(NVL(C.BELOW_COMORG_ALL_FLAG,'N'),'N',A.BUYER,'ALL')) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE ,DECODE(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, 'ALL','전체', NVL((SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE=A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) ,DECODE(NVL(C.BELOW_COMORG_ALL_FLAG,'N'),'Y', '전체', (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM NVL(A.RFQ_IMG_FLAG,'N') AS RFQ_IMG_FLAG , A.IMGFILE_DIR , A.IMGFILE_NAME , DECODE(A.IMGFILE_NAME,'','2','3') AS IMGFILE_NAME_IMG , B.IMGFILE_DIR AS QTDT_IMGFILE_DIR , B.IMGFILE_NAME AS QTDT_IMGFILE_NAME , DECODE(B.IMGFILE_NAME,'','2','3') AS QTDT_IMGFILE_NAME_IMG , A.TAX_TYPE , B.TAX_TYPE AS QTDT_TAX_TYPE_CODE , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'TX17' AND A, KEPQTDT B, KEP_BUYER_FLAG C WHERE (A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION) IN ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE SELECT /*selectMasterMpRqSellerChoice2PopHdList*/ DISTINCT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS BUYER_NAME , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) AS BTOA_USER_NAME , MAX(A.BTOA_DATE) AS BTOA_DATE , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_TEL) AS BTOA_USER_TEL , MAX(B.ATOS_END_DATE) AS ATOS_END_DATE , MAX(NVL(RATE.RATE_GUBUN, 'S')) AS BUYER_RATE_GUBUN , MAX((SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R'))) AS CATLG_CODE , MAX((SELECT NVL(TBL.TOT_RATE,0) AS BUYER_RATE FROM TBL_BUYER_PRIMECOST_MNG TBL WHERE TBL.BUYER=A.BUYER AND TBL.STATUS='C' AND TBL.PRIMECOST_STATUS='Y')) AS BUYER_RATE , CASE WHEN #{st_sour_dept_yn} = 'Y' THEN (SELECT NVL(TO_NUMBER(MAX(TEXT1)),'') FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMSG' AND COD.CODE1 = A.BUYER AND COD.CODE2 = A.SG_ID) ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN RATE.CONTRACT_FLAG = 'F' AND RATE.TO_DATE='299912' THEN RATE ELSE 0 END) END AS FEE_RATE , MAX(NVL(RATE.RATE_EDIT_FLAG, 'Y')) AS BUYER_RATE_EDIT FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B, KEP_BUYER_RATE RATE WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND B.STATUS <> 'O' AND A.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER=RATE.BUYER(+) AND RATE.FROM_DATE(+) <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND RATE.TO_DATE(+) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, A.SG_ID
